entities.name: otel-demo/Deployment/ad
entities.reasoning: ad pods entered CrashLoopBackOff due to OOMKilled, preventing the service from responding to any request.
entities.evidence: KubePodOOMKilled and KubePodCrashLooping alerts fired for ad pods; pod logs show out‑of‑memory termination.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/ad
entities.reasoning: Service object was healthy but its backing pods were dead, causing downstream request failures.
entities.evidence: Service endpoints list empty while ad pods are marked CrashLoopBackOff.

entities.name: otel-demo/Deployment/frontend
entities.reasoning: Frontend received 5xx responses because calls to ad service timed out.
entities.evidence: KubeServiceLatencyHigh alert on frontend; trace spans show failed HTTP calls to ad.

entities.name: otel-demo/Deployment/checkoutservice
entities.reasoning: Checkoutservice could not retrieve ad data, leading to request errors propagated to users.
entities.evidence: KubeServiceLatencyHigh alert on checkoutservice; logs show ad RPC errors.

entities.name: otel-demo/Deployment/cartservice
entities.reasoning: Cartservice depends on ad for recommendations and logged errors when ad was down.
entities.evidence: Error logs in cartservice reference ad service unavailable.

propagations.condition: Pods are in CrashLoopBackOff and not ready

propagations.effect: Frontend returns HTTP 500 errors to users

propagations.condition: Failed RPC to ad during checkout flow

propagations.effect: Cartservice logs errors and delays response

alerts_explained.explanation: Pod OOMKilled alerts indicate containers exceeded memory limits, matching ad pod terminations.
CrashLoopBackOff alerts fire when pods repeatedly fail to start, observed for ad pods.
Latency alerts on frontend, checkoutservice and cartservice correspond to downstream failures to call ad.
